Subject: MAP: Closure runlist & procurement/legal status

Team / Aaron — kicking off this week’s MAP runlist for BrightClinic. Goal: align on outstanding legal redlines, final order form values, and vendor setup so we can hit the planned 8/15 go-live. Quick summary up front:

- MSA: BrightClinic returned a redline. Marissa — your latest comments?
- Order form: Aaron requested an updated seat/usage table and professional services line item.
- Vendor setup: procurement needs vendor ID + W-9 to finish onboarding.

Please see the attached redlined_MSA_v3.pdf and order_form_v2.xlsx. Below I’ve captured the current status and proposed owners for the remaining items. Will plan a 30-min sync Wed 8/3 if needed — otherwise we’ll close asynchronously.

Current status (owners):
1) Legal redline review — outstanding: indemnity clause and data residency paragraph. Owner: Marissa Cole — ETA 8/2 EOD.
2) Order form finalization — confirm seat tiers + PS SOW. Owner: Jordan Blake — ETA 8/3 AM (will post updated file).
3) Vendor setup (BrightClinic) — vendor ID + W-9. Owner: Procurement Team / Aaron — ETA 8/4.
4) Finance credit terms approval (30 days vs 45). Owner: Sean Gallagher — ETA 8/2.

Action items (short):
- Marissa: send final MSA redline to Aaron with comments and accept/decline notes.
- Aaron / Procurement: upload vendor_setup_sheet.csv and W-9 to vendor portal.
- Jordan: update order_form_v2.xlsx with usage tiers and PS estimate; push to HubSpot.
- Sean: confirm credit terms and return approved language for the order form.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v3.pdf (comments highlighted), order_form_v2.xlsx

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron@brightclinic.health>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightclinic.health>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Closure runlist & procurement/legal status

Thanks Jordan — quick note from legal after an initial pass. I’ve attached redlined_MSA_v3.pdf with inline comments and a one-page summary. High-level:

- Indemnity: BrightClinic added a reciprocal indemnity section that’s broader than standard for our tiered SaaS agreement. I propose we offer a capped liability at $X and carveouts for third-party data processors.
- Data residency: They asked for EU-specific residency language. Since BrightClinic will host PHI in US regions, we can offer a limited clause that documents access controls and not a permanent residency guarantee.
- Audit rights: remove broad audit language; propose quarterly reports + SOC2 report sharing.

I can prepare a tracked-redline response for Aaron with our alternative language and rationale. Targeting EOD 8/2 for that draft. If Aaron needs us to accept a small change to indemnity in exchange for a revenue or term concession, flag it here and we can escalate.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redlined_MSA_v3.pdf

Jordan / team — thanks for the clear runlist. Quick responses from procurement on our side:

- W-9 and vendor paperwork: attached vendor_setup_sheet.csv (contains vendor contact & tax info) — procurement@brightclinic.health will upload to your vendor portal today.
- Order form: we need the professional services line broken into delivery milestone buckets and a one-time implementation fee. Can you add a PS SOW summary line to the order form?

We aim to finish internal approvals by 8/6 so we can sign the week of 8/9. If you can post the revised order form and redline response by EOD 8/3 we’ll be able to route it through contracting and finance next week.

- Marissa will send a tracked-response to BrightClinic with proposed indemnity cap and alternate language for data residency by EOD 8/3.
- I’ve attached order_form_v2.xlsx (updated): added PS SOW summary, one-time implementation fee row, and the requested seat/usage tiers. Please confirm the PS milestone split 50/30/20 or suggest an alternate split.
- Sean confirms 30-day net payment term is approved for this deal; he’ll send the approved language for the order form tomorrow morning.
- Kimberly will trigger vendor setup once the W-9 is uploaded and will confirm vendor ID by 8/4.

If we hit these dates, legal and procurement expect to have final counters ready by 8/6 and sign-off the week of 8/9. I’ll schedule a 15-min check-in for 8/4 10:00 AM PT only if any owner misses an ETA — otherwise we’ll close asynchronously.
